title: The range of $$\arccos(x)$$
text: Compare to the standard range of $$\arccos(x), $$ which is $$[0, \pi].$$

title: Graph the function
text: A negative sign outside the function reflects the graph across the $$x-$$ axis.\n##figure1.gif##

figureAlts.figure1.gif: Graph showing two curves sharing a domain from x equals negative one to x equals positive one. The horizontal axis is x, and the vertical axis is theta.  The first dotted gray curve, theta equals arccosine of x, is strictly decreasing. It starts at the point negative one comma pi; passes through zero comma pi over two; and ends at the point one comma zero. The second blue solid curve, theta equals negative arccosine of x, is its reflection across the x-axis. It is strictly increasing, starting at the point negative one comma negative pi; passing through zero comma negative pi over two; and ending at the point one comma zero.

title: Set up the inequality
text: $$0$$ $$\leq$$ $$\arccos(x)$$ $$\leq$$ $$\pi$$ \n Multplying through by $$-1$$ flips the inequalities and we have\n$$0$$ $$\geq$$ $$-\arccos(x)$$ $$\geq$$ $$-\pi$$
